title: How to make ChatGPT forget you #chatgpt #tutorial
description:
Take control of your ChatGPT privacy settings today.

Learn how to stop your data from being used for model training and manage your chat history effectively. This guide walks you through disabling memory and deleting conversations to keep your information secure.

Subscribe for more practical tips on managing your AI data footprint.
